dashboard.settings.autoAcceptHelp: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested time slot is full, the order moves to the next free time slot. It only confirms when the kitchen still has capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) still need confirming.
dashboard.settings.layoutHelp: How items appear on the “Add order” screen.
dashboard.settings.layoutTabsHelp: Show one category at a time. Tap a category to switch. Best for long menus, where each item always stays in the same place.
dashboard.settings.layoutScrollHelp: Show all items in one scrolling list, with a heading for each category. There are no category buttons — you scroll to move around. Best for short menus, where you can see most of it at once.
dashboard.settings.paidStepHelp: Adds a “Confirm” button when you add an order yourself, so you can place it now and take payment later.
dashboard.settings.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into “Cash” and “Card”.
dashboard.settings.orderReadyHelp: Shows a “Mark as ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens (KDS) are set separately. Customers get an email whenever an order is marked as ready.
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptTitle: Remind me to give a buzzer
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptHelp: Opens the buzzer number grid as soon as you place an order, so the number shows on the board while the customer is standing in front of you. With it off you can still give a buzzer any time by tapping the order, but nothing reminds you. Useful where you hand out buzzers, and easy to switch off where you do not.
dashboard.settings.cardsHelp: Turn it off when there is a card problem and customers will place orders as normal and pay when collecting instead. Orders keep coming in; only the card payment step stops.
dashboard.settings.cardsScope: This applies to your whole Food Truck, on every event, and stays off until you turn it back on.
